messages:
jas: Following up from today's all-hands with a short list of clarifying Qs for leadership. Keeping it tight so we can publish a small FAQ.

jas: 1) One-sentence mission we should put in customer-facing materials?

maria: "Make inference predictable, cost-efficient, and operable everywhere engineers ship models." Simple and covers the key promises.

jas: 2) Best one-liner vs major cloud providers?

ash: We focus on production levers (batching, KV caching, quant profiles) + observability and rollout controls rather than just model access. Same API ergonomics, better production economics.

ron: Add that we surface token-level cost & p95 latency analytics — engineers can tune to business goals.

jas: 3) Who's our highest-priority buyer in the next 12 months? startups, platform teams, or enterprise?

maria: Target: AI-first startups + mid-market product teams; platform teams are the amplification channel. Enterprise/private stays strategic and requires dedicated motions.

jas: 4) Should marketing lean "build vs buy" or call out cloud comparisons up front?

ash: Start with build vs buy. In the mid-funnel have a "vs Cloud" appendix with concrete TCO and latency comparisons. Avoid vendor names on hero content.

jas: 5) Can we publish a short public FAQ from this thread?

maria: Yes. Under 700 words, include one anonymized benchmark, and link to a tech appendix. I'll coordinate with legal on anonymization.

km-bot: All-hands recording + slides -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/3311112222

jas: Thanks all ":white_check_mark:" tagging owners: @maria (FAQ + legal), @ash (benchmarks). Closing thread after follow-ups.
